Standard: Riding (or anchor) light(s) required for seaplanes or amphibious air vehicles is installed so that it will show a white light for at least two miles under clear atmospheric conditions and show maximum unbroken light when moored or drifting. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Riding light performance is verified by geometric analysis. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct a flight demonstration to verify the riding light performance at a minimum range of two miles when moored or drifting.
